title: US Army awards $192M to Palantir, Anduril for TITAN production
description: The Army moved its TITAN program from prototyping to production with a $192 million award to Palantir and Anduril this week.

title: Ousted Ukrainian defense chief lands Palantir CEO as first investor in new venture
description: Ukraine’s recently ousted defense minister Mykhailo Fedorov is teaming up with Palantir CEO Alex Karp to launch a new defense company.
